description: She wears a deep plum textured opaque gown with a low square neckline, structured fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and floor-length skirt. Narrow gold geometric woven borders run around the neckline, bodice seams, sleeves, waist and long front skirt opening. A circular gold ornamental clasp centers the decorated girdle. A cream underdress shows through the lower front opening, while a cream shoulder wrap with plum-and-gold borders lies loosely around her forearms and hangs down the sides. Her visible closed-toe brown shoe bears gold patterned ornament. Small gold drop earrings and a fine necklace with a small round pendant accompany the dress. No headgear or weapon is present.
